integrity: The eligible source supplies the generic diameter-three homogeneous metric setting and Primary MSC 03C10. The proof derives the one-point constraints directly from triangle inequalities, identifies the graph-metric slice with the fully reflexive P3 target, and imports only the published fixed-target #P theorem. The verifier exhausts all labeled graph-metrics through five vertices coefficientwise and all six-vertex graphs at scalar level.
scientific_limitations: The #P-completeness of the Widom–Rowlinson partition function is prior; novelty is restricted to the metric-model-theoretic type-polynomial identification, component factorization, and sharp type-count envelope.

The finding is proved on the graph-metric slice using only distances 1 and 2; it does not give a closed formula for arbitrary finite {1,2,3}-metric parameter spaces, where distance-3 pairs add a second local exclusion.
The bridge may be folklore because both Katětov one-point extensions and the Widom–Rowlinson homomorphism formulation are standard; targeted searches did not locate the combined statement.
title: Widom–Rowlinson partition functions as 1-type polynomials of the generic diameter-3 metric space
